comparison.objective: Extinguish a candle before packing a vase.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a snuffer accurately, then transport and place a rigid object while respecting a safety prerequisite.
comparison.success_condition: Flame extinguished first, candle unmoved, vase packed upright, released and still.
comparison.reason: Its core is safety sequencing plus ordinary placement; it neither handles a loaded screen nor separates constituents.
